onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/overview/quick_tune.schema.json, set qt_move_speed to {{qt_move_speed}}]
Set the character move speed to {{qt_move_speed}} in MovementAbility.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/overview/quick_tune.schema.json, set qt_jump_impulse to {{qt_jump_impulse}}]
Set the character jump impulse to {{qt_jump_impulse}} in JumpAbility.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/overview/quick_tune.schema.json, set qt_camera_dist to {{qt_camera_dist}}]
Set the camera targetDistance to {{qt_camera_dist}} in ThirdPersonCamera.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/overview/quick_tune.schema.json, set qt_gravity to {{qt_gravity}}]
Set gravity magnitude to {{qt_gravity}} (gravity = Vec3(0, -{{qt_gravity}}, 0)) in CharacterForceControllerBase.
